approvers: Main contractor or developer would have to specify and pay for it
reason: We spend about 1,800 euro a year on handover damage and cover it from the job contingency. At 19 euro per m2 one block of glazing would cost more than a whole year of damage. It doesn't pay for us.
objection: The coating costs more than the damage it prevents. It is also one more trade on site and one more thing that has to come off cleanly before handover.
instead: Keep doing nothing: clean, polish or replace at snagging from the contingency. Use cheap film or tape on the worst spots if a block needs it.
would_change_my_mind: A main contractor or developer who puts it in the tender as a paid line, so it is not my cost. Or a price at the cost of a roll of film, with a local reference job showing no glass or frame damage.
